items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: because one time they had Jack Benny with him, doing his comedy, and they had it on the radio.

ctx.x: . . . yes, yes, I do call it, because they brought the music to you. They really did. That’s where I met Julie London, people like that, got to know them, know their hearts were in [the] business, and understood them as artists, because listening to that radio – Tommy Dorsey was on a show with somebody [?], because one time they had Jack Benny with him, doing his comedy, and they had it on the radio.
But didn’t you also sing with your mom and your sisters?
